name: Unarmored Defense
description: While you aren't wearing any armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Your training allows you to use the mastery properties of 2 kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice, such as Greataxes and Handaxes. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of those weapon choices. See Weapon Mastery cards for property details.
